notes.title: Single Player Update
notes.notes:
Single Player Support


You can now play against the computer in 1v1, 1v2 or 2v2 matches.

If you play with a buddy, you can choose either to have a CPU teammate each and play against each other, or face off together against two CPU opponents.

CPU players have three difficulty levels:

Drunk (easy)

Tipsy (medium)

Sober (hard)


Side view added
Turns out it wasn't that difficult to implement, so I've added the option to switch to a side view.

There are two options:

Fixed Side View: the camera shows the whole playfield

Dynamic Side View: the camera frames and follows the players plus the ball.


Other minor fixes
Graphics elements added to Ship scene.

Controller assignment redesigned.

Keyboard support has been enhanced, mostly in terms of GUI.

Several bugs fixed.

notes.title: Update One notes
notes.notes:
New stuff:

 Implemented localization. Supported languages are English, Hungarian, Polish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese, French, Russian, Spanish and German.
 Added feature to invite Steam Friends in-game via Remote Play Together.
 Implemented goalpost indicators. They indicate the direction of attack when the goalpost is off-screen.
 Implemented keyboard support. Available for one local player only.
 Added ability to grab and hold nearest enemy player with hands.
 Added simple and advanced control scheme


Fixes:

 Endless OUT loop bug.
 Adjusted collision matrix so player foot collides with less objects, thus making it easier to get around obstacles


Changes:

 Changed gamepad layout to better suit grabbing feature.
 Temporarily disabled Tutorial until controls are confirmed.


Removals:
[olist]
 Removed feature vertical jump.
 Removed camera free look. It was confusing players.
[/olist]
